visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young Asian women sit side-by-side on a soft sofa in a warmly lit indoor environment. The woman on the left has shoulder-length blonde hair and wears a thick, light-grey textured knitted sweater. The woman on the right has short dark curly hair and a black top. They both smile at the camera, posing with hand gestures under their chins in a playful, friendly manner. (2) A close-up shot focuses on two white ceramic bowls filled with a traditional Asian sweet soup containing peanuts, white taro balls, and grains. A silver spoon rests next to one of the bowls on a wooden table. The lighting is soft, highlighting the textures of the food items. (3) The curly-haired woman is seen from the chest up in a restaurant or cafe setting. She uses her hands to frame her face while looking at her smartphone which lies on the table in front of her. In the background, other patrons and a counter area are visible in soft focus. (4) A hand holds a white and brown bag of 'bruno Chocolate Brownie Crisp' against a neutral indoor background. The camera then cuts to a close-up of several dark chocolate brownie pieces with embedded nuts arranged on a white floral-patterned plate. (5) The blonde woman stands in what appears to be a home kitchen with wooden cabinets. She holds the brownie bag, opens it, and takes out a piece to eat, showing a satisfied facial expression. (6) A montage of short clips shows the blonde woman with a young man and a baby in various home settings, suggesting a family context. They are seen laughing and interacting warmly. (7) Product focus shifts to 'DROAS' brand shampoo and hair treatment bottles with blue and pink labels displayed on a retail shelf. Hands are shown dispensing the clear liquid and applying it to blonde hair, creating white soapy foam. (8) The blonde woman stands in front of a mirror in a bathroom, running her fingers through her freshly washed and dried hair, checking its smoothness and shine. (9) A yellow package of 'numbuzin 5+ Vita-C' mask is shown. Hands tear the top of the package and squeeze out clear essence. The blonde woman then appears with glowing, clear skin on her face, touching her cheek to demonstrate the effect. (10) The final scene returns to the two women from the beginning. They are laughing together, covering their mouths with their hands, and waving goodbye to the camera in a very cheerful and lively manner.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 跟日本朋友見面聚會. (2) [Subtitle]: 最愛聊的就是美妝保養 健康食品. (3) [Subtitle]: 今天推薦四個. (4) [Subtitle]: 我的日本朋友推到爆的商品. (5) [Subtitle]: 第一個 bruno 巧克力布朗尼脆片. (6) [Subtitle]: 我好多日本朋友 都有買這個解嘴饞. (7) [Subtitle]: 使用對身體溫和的成分製成的健康餅乾. (8) [Subtitle]: 香脆又好吃 可以較無負擔的享受甜食. (9) [Subtitle]: 我推薦給老公後. (10) [Subtitle]: 他說吃起來有媽媽小時候做的餅乾的味道. (11) [Subtitle]: 上網一次訂了好幾包. (12) [Subtitle]: 第二個 DROAS 礦物泥洗護系列. (13) [Subtitle]: 礦物泥是日本近幾年非常夯的保養元素. (14) [Subtitle]: 這款洗護使用摩洛哥熔岩泥和高嶺土為基底. (15) [Subtitle]: 泥的吸附力能溫和帶走頭皮多餘的皮脂與污垢. (16) [Subtitle]: 礦物質含有美容保濕成分能修護滋潤髮尾. (17) [Subtitle]: 用完頭皮可以保持長時間的清爽狀態. (18) [Subtitle]: 懶得洗頭的朋友請舉手買起來. (19) [Subtitle]: 依照不同功能推出兩個系列. (20) [Subtitle]: 像我常染髮導致髮絲較脆弱 就比較喜歡用粉色款. (21) [Subtitle]: 現在在台灣 屈臣氏也買得到囉. (22) [Subtitle]: 第三個 潤碧之茵 五號面膜. (23) [Subtitle]: 好多地方都缺貨的超紅面膜. (24) [Subtitle]: 又被稱為高濃度濃縮美白安瓶. (25) [Subtitle]: 敷完肌膚會變得很水潤 提亮和保濕都非常有感. (26) [Subtitle]: 推薦和我也一樣很累導致肌膚暗沉的職業媽媽. (27) [Subtitle]: 第四個 Milbon 雜毛整理棒. (28) [Subtitle]: 呆毛不知道怎麼整理的朋友必買!!. (29) [Subtitle]: 一根刷上去馬上服服貼貼. (30) [Subtitle]: 這款刷毛部分設計比一般市面上的還要長更好操作定型. (31) [Subtitle]: 我自己也用掉好幾支了. (32) [Subtitle]: 以上就是這次和朋友的美妝交流分享啦. (33) [Subtitle]: 不知道大家喜歡這樣的影片嗎.
